The rules of this game are simple – each player tries to catch as many fish as possible from the rotating water surface using a fishing rod. The mechanical fish open and close their mouths, and the aim is for them to 'bite' the end of the player's rod so they can be pulled out of the water. Cheerful music accompanies the rotation of the game board, and each player is assigned a removable coloured basket for their caught fish.
